s.note: the birthday party the toys spy on
s.how: Mix 500g pork sausage mince with 1 grated carrot and 1 grated onion. Lay along 2 sheets puff pastry, roll up, egg wash and cut into 20 small rolls. Bake at 200C for 25 minutes. Serve with tomato sauce.
Blanch 200g peas and 200g edamame for 2 minutes and drain. Toss with chopped mint, lemon zest and juice, 2 tbsp olive oil and flaky salt. Spoon into little toy buckets or cups.

m.how: Roast 1kg tomatoes, an onion and 3 garlic cloves at 200C for 30 minutes, blend with 250ml stock and 100ml cream. Fill 8 slices sourdough with 150g cheddar and 100g mozzarella, butter the outsides and grill slowly until golden.

w.note: with a cowboy hat on top
w.how: Beat 200g butter and 250g sugar, add 4 eggs, then fold in 250g self-raising flour, 50g cocoa and 200ml milk. Bake in two tins at 175C for 30 minutes. Cover in 200g butter beaten with 350g icing sugar and 40g cocoa. Top with a fondant cowboy hat and candles.

d.how: Blitz 150ml blue raspberry cordial with 500ml lemonade and 4 cups of ice until slushy. Pour into four cups with spoon straws and drink it to infinity and beyond.
